THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MOTOR  VEHICLES ACT, PRAYING TO, JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED  17.02.2011 IN MVC NO.2568/2008 BY THE MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS  TRIBUNAL, BAILHONGAL IN AWARDING THE COMPENSATION OF  RS.4,20,000/- AND INTEREST AT RATE OF 6% FROM THE DATE OF  PETITION AND MAY BE KINDLY MODIFIED BY ENHANCING AS PRAYED  FOR WITH 18% INTEREST AND HOLDING 50% CONTRIBUTORY  NEGLIGENCE ON THE RESPONDENT NO.2 MAY KINDLY BE SET ASIDE  IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS MFA COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
 JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -2-  NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900  MFA No. 101630 of 2014 HC-KAR CORAM:

THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVI V.HOSMANI  ORAL JUDGMENT Challenging judgment and award dated 17.02.2011 passed by Member, Addl. Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bailhongal ('Tribunal', for short) in MVC no.2568/2008, this appeal is filed.

entities.text: Addl. Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bailhongal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Sri Yash Nadakarni, advocate appearing for Sri Vitthal S.Teli, learned counsel for appellants submitted that appeal was by claimant for enhancement of compensation as well as challenging finding of tribunal and apportionment of negligence.

It was submitted, at 11:15 a.m. on 09.09.2008,
when Channaya Hiremath was pillion rider on Scooty no.KA-22/J- 3588 along with Peersab on NH-4 near Kittur, driver of NWKRTC Bus no.KA-22/F-1457 drove it in rash and negligent manner and dashed against Scooty causing accident.
In accident, Channayya sustained fatal injuries and died.
Alleging loss of dependency on account of his sudden demise, his wife and mother filed claim petition against NWKRTC as well as owner of Scooty under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
Even other pillion rider Peersab sustained grievous injuries.
Separate claim petition was filed.
Both were clubbed.
They were opposed on all counts.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900 HC-KAR 3.
Based on pleadings, tribunal framed issues and recorded evidence.
Claimant no.1 along with three others deposed as PWs1 to 4 and got marked Exhibits P1 to P12.

Respondent did not lead evidence,

2 but got marked post-mortem report as Ex.R1.

sentences.text: On consideration, tribunal held accident occurred due to joint negligence of rider of Scooty and driver of NWKRTC Bus to extent of 50% each and held NWKRTC liable to pay 50% of compensation.
Besides compensation granted was also on lower side.
Therefore, appeal was filed.
4. It was submitted, as on date of accident, deceased was 36 years of age working as agriculturist and earning 6,000/- per month.
However, tribunal erred in taking monthly income at 3,000/- and without adding future prospects, awarded inadequate compensation.
It was submitted, even compensation under conventional heads was not commensurate and sought enhancement.
On said ground sought for allowing appeal.
5. There is no representation for respondent no.1.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900 HC-KAR 6.
Since matter is of year 2014 and listed for final hearing, it is taken up for disposal.

7. Heard learned counsel, perused impugned judgment and award and record.
8.

From above and since claimant is assailing finding of tribunal on quantum as well as apportionment of negligence, points that arise for consideration are:
1. Whether claimant is entitled for enhancement of compensation? and 2. Whether tribunal erred in holding driver of NWKRTC Bus negligent to extent of 50% only?
9. Point no.1:
Though claimant stated that he was 36 years of age working as agriculturist and earning 6,000/- per month, same was not substantiated.

Therefore, notional income was taken,
but notional income for year 2008 being 4,250/-, tribunal was not justified in taking it at 3,000/-.
Tribunal rightly deducted 1/3rd towards personal expenses.
However, it erred in not adding future prospects as per National Insurance Company Limited v. Pranay Sethi and Others reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Limited v. Pranay Sethi and Others reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Appropriate multiplier applicable would be NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900 HC-KAR '15' and extent of future prospects to be added would be 40%.

Thus, compensation towards loss of dependency would be:
(4,250 + 40% - 1/3rd) x 12 x 15 = 7,14,060/-.
10. Claimants are wife and mother.
Therefore, they would be entitled to 40,000/- each towards loss of consortium apart from 15,000/- towards loss of estate and 15,000/- towards funeral expenses.
Since more than 6 years have lapsed after decision in Pranay Sethi, 20% has to be added to compensation under conventional heads i.e. 22,000/-.
Thus, total compensation would be 8,46,060/-.
Point no.1 is answered 'partly in affirmative'.

sentences.text: Point no.2:

It is seen that there is no dispute between parties about involvement of insured vehicle in accident and about rider having valid and effective driving licence as well as its currency covering date of accident.
Tribunal apportioned 50% negligence against rider of Scooty on ground that he had taken two pillion riders.
Other reason for apportionment of negligence was fact that accident spot sketch indicated rider of Scooty was on wrong side at time of accident and contributed NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900 HC-KAR negligence.

But Hon'ble Supreme Court in its decision in Khenyei v. New India Assurance Co. Ltd. reported in (2015) 9 SCC 273 has held in case of an accident involving multiple vehicles due to contributory negligence by riders/drivers of both, third party claimants would be entitled to proceed against owner/insurer of any one of joint tortfeasors for entire compensation and denial would not be justified.

entities.text: Khenyei v. New India Assurance Co. Ltd. reported in (2015) 9 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of above ratio, even though negligence may have been apportioned, insurer cannot escape liability to third party claimant.
12. In view of above, Point no.2 is answered 'partly in affirmative'.

Consequently, following:
ORDER i. Appeal is allowed in part.
ii. Judgment and award dated 17.02.2011 passed by Membjer, Addl. MACT,
Bailhongal in MVC no.2568/2008 is modified.
iii.
Claimant is held entitled for total reassessed compensation of 8,46,060/- from respondents jointly and severally to entire extent.

Same shall carry interest at 6% p.a.
from date of petition till date of deposit.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:4900 HC-KAR iv.
Insurer is directed to deposit compensation before tribunal within six weeks.
v. On deposit, directions by Tribunal regarding apportionment, deposit and release shall apply to reassessed compensation proportionately.

vi. It is clarified that apportionment of negligence is not disturbed & NWKRTC would be at liberty to proceed against owner of Scooty in same proceedings, but after paying entire compensation to claimants.

Sd/-
